pages.text: Set a Torch beside the trail before nightfall. A torch marks the route and keeps the workbench visible from a distance.$(br2)The camp chest should also contain Bread, a spare pickaxe, and a stack of Cobblestone.
Bread is easy to carry on a long survey. Cobblestone makes a stable footing over water, and Glass lets the crew watch the weather without leaving shelter.
At the end of each route, return the spare Torch and Bread to the supply crate. These familiar item names appear in full sentences to exercise ordinary English name matching.
